description: Provisional public extraction contract. Replace with the team's approved contract before benchmarking gold compatibility.

structures.structure_name: Name of the structure, retaining distinct sites or segments.
structures.structure_type: Structure type explicitly stated in the source.
structures.location: Location as stated, without inferred coordinates.
structures.construction_year: Construction year as stated. Do not infer from age.
structures.exposure_environment: Water type and exposure explicitly stated.

reports.inspection_date: Inspection date, range, or partial date exactly as stated. Not the publication date.
reports.report_date: Report issue/publication date exactly as stated.
reports.inspecting_firm: Inspection firm or agency as stated.
reports.inspection_type: Inspection type and methods as stated.
reports.inspection_coverage: Coverage, level, inspected areas, and explicitly uninspected areas.
reports.limitations: Inspection limitations stated in the report.
reports.rating_scale_raw: Rating system as stated, without converting scales.

observations.structure_name: Name of the structure this individual finding belongs to.
observations.component: Component or element this finding belongs to.
observations.location_on_structure: Station, elevation, face, or segment as stated, including datum.
observations.finding: One distinct finding or measurement. Do not merge unrelated defects.
observations.defect_type: Defect type described by this finding, retaining source terminology.
observations.rating_raw: Rating of this finding/component exactly as written.
observations.rating_scale_raw: Stated rating system for this finding.
observations.measurement: Measurement exactly as stated, including ranges or approximations.
observations.unit: Unit as stated for that measurement.
observations.temporal_context: Current condition, historical comparison, completed repair, or proposed work, as supported by the source.
observations.recommended_action: Action recommended for this finding, using the report's wording.
observations.priority_raw: Urgency or priority exactly as stated. Do not invent a rank.
